remarks: Welcome to this exquisite Mid-Century Modern home, nestled on a private acre in the highly sought-after Delafield Island Association in Darien. This peaceful property is situated on a quiet cul-de-sac, offering both privacy and convenience - minutes to town, train, schools, Pear Tree Point Beach and Great Island. The living room features a wood burning fireplace and three expansive picture windows, which flood the home with natural light and views of mature landscaping. The dining room, a proper solarium, offers a bright and open setting for dining. A spacious eat in kitchen and open floor plan seamlessly connect the living spaces, elevating the home's modern sensibility. With four generously sized bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, 22 Sunswyck exhibits effortless single-level living, in comfort and sophistication.
